name: Cinte Tesino (Italy)
description: Navy blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cinte Tesino (a fir tree on a mount on red) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI above and CINTE TESINO below in white.
history: Municipal flag of Cinte Tesino, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Cinte Tesino arms — fir tree on a mount on red, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI above and CINTE TESINO below the arms
